scope: Every deliberate store selection writes a fresh generation, including a same-name selection. Existing string-returning callers remain compatible.
Physical dispatch captures the exact persisted selection digest and rechecks it at its existing effect/result boundaries; independent stores cannot hide a committed away-and-back selection.
Absent and legacy records are read without migration or writes. A fresh request after a peer round trip uses the final selection normally.
Local departure-attempt generation still fences failed transitions. Already queued commands preserve their original authenticated session; stale result history refuses.
limitations: This adds persisted change detection; it does not hold a global selection lease across an external native operation or detect manual restoration of byte-identical old selection files.
No real workspace selection, native provider/window, account, model, keyboard or frontend operation was used; encrypted temporary stores and authenticated synthetic agent messages are explicit.
The correction postdates installed 384cf8b, complete Linux 0c7d918 and native Windows client 0bb7fd4.
